threshold_definition: Maximum cell liquid-water moles at drying end divided by that same cell initial t=0 liquid-water moles. Excludes pore vapor and bound hydrogen.

three_denominators.acceptance: Initial wet body cell liquid inventory at t=0.
three_denominators.drying_stage_ledger_initial: Start of constant-temperature drying, at end of drying_ramp.
three_denominators.frozen_root_n_eq_over_n0: Current cell liquid inventory at drying endpoint; not original initial water.

water.retention_scale.note: Water-equivalent mass scale per initial dry mass defining initial matrix equivalents N0 for mixing and saturated binding. Current N follows the separately declared kaolin-carried site hypothesis. Not added matter, a measured site count or maximum sorption capacity. Zero N0 removes all retention.

water.binding_energy.note: Positive binding-energy magnitude at the existing thermodynamic reference temperature. The free-energy term is -E*g at that temperature; not a measured adsorption enthalpy.

water.binding_heat_capacity.note: Positive excess heat capacity per effective bound equivalent. Constant over the virtual schedule; no experimental high-temperature adsorption law. With zero binding energy and zero capacity, recover preceding ideal-mixing retention.

water.site_survival_fraction.note: Persistent fraction of initial matrix equivalents after kaolin depletion. Nominal 20 percent, range 10 to 100 percent are declared hypotheses, not measured. Evolving mode requires positive initial kaolin. At one recover fixed sites exactly; complete site loss is outside this model domain. No new mass or independent state.

kinetics.evaporation.A.note: Assumed effective first order kinetics. Organic CH2O and carbon are separate proxies.

gas.stage.drying.H2O.note: Declared endpoint mole fraction; four species sum to one. Virtual boundary condition, fixed in this conditional UQ, not a measured or optimized firing atmosphere.

acceptance.drying_remaining_fraction.note: Strict drying-end criterion: maximum cell liquid-water moles divided by that same cell liquid-water inventory at simulation t=0. This dimensionless fraction is not dry-basis or wet-basis moisture and excludes pore vapor and mineral-bound hydrogen. The equivalent dry-basis limit equals this value times material.water_dry_ratio. The drying-stage ledger starts at the drying_ramp endpoint; conditional_equilibrium.n_eq_over_n0 instead uses the current drying-end cell water as its denominator. These three time references must not be interchanged.

nominal.closure_interpretation: Endpoint ledger mismatch is not a bound on solution error. Inferred internal redistribution is not independent flux evidence. Signed original residuals remain unchanged.

algebraic_diagnostic.expression: At n_target=threshold*n_initial, evaluate A-RT*log(n_target/(n_target+N))-B*(N/(n_target+N))^2 using saved same-state A,B,T,N.
algebraic_diagnostic.boundary_term_expression: Add RT*log(p_H2O_external/p_H2O_local) only; all other terms held fixed.
algebraic_diagnostic.sign_meaning: Positive mu_vapor-mu_liquid corresponds to condensation in the declared reversible law. Negative current endpoint affinity means evaporation remains active.
algebraic_diagnostic.monotonicity: For R,T,N>0 and B<0, derivative with respect to n is -RT*N/[n*(n+N)] + 2*B*N^2/(n+N)^3 < 0.
algebraic_diagnostic.scope: Fixed-condition algebra, not a coupled admissible new state, trajectory, time-to-dry estimate, global steady state, actual material or new process qualification.

source_review.review_scope: Targeted current endpoint definition, stage indexing, shared temperature/gas times, boundary partial pressure, same-state affinity, phase-source signs and water coordinate. Not a proof that all implementation or numerical defects are absent.

historical_control.scope: Historical coupled binding-disabled contrast only. Different version; not a new current-kernel control or accepted replacement for nominal failure.

next_boundary: No evidence justifies modifying the forward law or starting a third drying search. Same-material moisture/isotherm/time-temperature/humidity evidence or an explicitly scoped new constitutive/process question is needed for a further physical claim. Existing surrogate approximations remain documented.

independent_review.scope: Targeted source semantics and one representative new algebraic diagnostic, not repeated historical verification.
independent_review.comparison: Agrees with saved P09 values to floating-point rounding; units, signs and three denominators checked.

delivery_receipts.scope: Actual normal successor/push and small increment metadata results are recorded separately from this scientific artifact; cloud recovery and historical storage remain unqualified.
